name: hairness/workspaces
description: Scoped shared and personal continuity for a Hairness Home.

capabilities.description: Resolve or create the one Home or Desk Workspace that owns durable work.
Capture and route explicitly deferred matter in its owning Workspace.
Record one accepted decision in its owning Workspace.
Inspect Workspace contracts and propose bounded repairs without implicit cleanup.
Archive or restore inactive Workspace material while preserving one durable copy.

skills.description: Use when durable work needs one explicit shared Home or personal Desk owner.
Use when deferred matter should be captured or reviewed without starting work.
Use when an accepted decision should become a durable Workspace Document.
Use when Workspace structure or ownership needs a read-only hygiene inspection.
Use when inactive Workspace material must be archived or restored explicitly.

commands.description: Resolve or create a scoped Workspace.
Capture or review Workspace Inbox matter.
Archive or restore Workspace material explicitly.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one atomic Home or Desk Workspace.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List Workspaces across Home and the current Desk.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check Workspace identity, layout and ownership without mutation.
